scope: CVG-003 durable repository-backed source of truth for GET /audit/operational-coverage

criteria.description: Repository mode derives operational coverage from the complete committed account snapshot returned by listForCacheRefresh, excluding stale cache-only events and avoiding the default 100-row page.
criteria.limitations: This certifies the selected local repository boundary, not a multi-replica target deployment.

criteria.description: A configured repository without a complete snapshot capability or with a failed snapshot read fails closed through AuditCoverageUnavailableError, and the HTTP route maps the failure to sanitized 503 AUDIT_COVERAGE_UNAVAILABLE.
criteria.limitations: The error boundary is proven in local module and route tests; external error aggregation is outside scope.

criteria.description: The route preserves principal-derived account scope, audit.read authorization, report JSON compatibility, pre-read snapshot timing and awaited metadata-only success auditing.
criteria.limitations: This gate does not generalize the route contract to unrelated audit/log/trace/export routes.

criteria.description: Live disposable PostgreSQL and runtime restart evidence prove deterministic complete snapshots, historical legacy identity compatibility and committed-state visibility after a fresh runtime.
criteria.limitations: The RLS child gate is a separate bounded gate reconciled as a dependency; target migration state is not claimed.

criteria.description: TDD, module, API and build regressions pass: intentional RED was recorded, audit module passed 27/27, focused route passed 14/14, runtime restart passed 1/1 and the final full API passed 496/496.
criteria.limitations: Local regressions do not replace remote CI or release acceptance.

criteria.description: Coverage and quality gates pass with official workspace coverage above the required threshold and green RLS, migration-source, OpenAPI, secret, formatting and diff checks.
criteria.limitations: Workspace-local quality evidence does not certify target accessibility, operations or backup/recovery.

criteria.description: Independent review of the final source-of-truth implementation and its restricted-role RLS dependency returned APPROVE with no in-scope findings.
criteria.limitations: Review approval is bounded to the selected repository slice.

criteria.description: Global non-promotion is preserved after parent/child reconciliation: ERP remains IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL, Vetus parity is 4/11, clinical parity is 2/3, readiness is 95/100 and promotion is BLOCKED.
criteria.limitations: This is a control-plane assertion and not a global readiness verdict.

gaps: This gate does not certify target-cluster migration application, production, providers, credentials, remote CI or release acceptance.
Global Vetus parity remains 4/11 and clinical parity remains 2/3; enterprise readiness remains 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.
Replay-after-revocation/idempotency, durable audit atomicity, systemic ABAC and other cross-system ERP boundaries remain separate residuals.
conditions: Preserve complete committed snapshot semantics, no stale-cache fallback, principal account scope and sanitized 503 behavior.
Keep the legacy RLS correction under its separate bounded child gate and preserve migration 0003/helpers.
Keep the operational requirements catalog, unrelated audit routes, mutation semantics, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment and release scope outside this gate.
Keep CVG-003/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Do not infer target, production, provider, deployment or release acceptance from this local gate.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and the implementation-ready parent/child gates
authority.scope: Repository-backed operational coverage source, route contract, complete database snapshot behavior and the separately gated tenant-safe legacy RLS dependency
authority.decision: Authorize bounded local closure of the operational-coverage source-of-truth slice after its child RLS dependency is verified. Exclude unrelated audit routes, mutation semantics, replay/idempotency, durable atomicity, systemic ABAC, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing requirements, report shape, global cache recovery, mutation transactions, another audit route, any policy outside audit_events or any external/production boundary.

next_action: Fresh-scout the next repository-local P1/P2 gap under a new implementation-ready authority. Do not promote CVG-003 or global ERP readiness.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to the operational requirements catalog or report JSON shape
Changes to global cache recovery, mutation transactions or durable audit semantics
Changes to other audit/log/trace/export routes, replay/idempotency or ABAC
Expansion to providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release scope
